survivorship.note: f_stock counts listed common stocks missing from the price cache by number of stocks. For a screen that selects beaten-down stocks it is a LOWER bound: those are the stocks that disappear. f_bottom_scenario assumes every stock that was delisted within two years was in the bottom state.

verdict_rule: 'edge' only if ALL of: (1) C0 net E[R] > 0; (2) the C0-minus-C3v excess has a 95% CI whose lower bound is > 0 under BOTH month and half-year clustering; (3) the C0-minus-C2 excess mean is > 0; (4) adjusted_expectancy(E, f_ref, -1.3) > 0, where f_ref is the C0-trade-weighted share of listed common stocks missing from the price data (f_stock) over signal years >= 2013. Otherwise 'no demonstrated edge'. A missing input gives 'incomplete (missing: ...)'. Stability configurations never change the verdict.
